extraction.auto_accept_precision.why: Auto-accepted values skip human review; they must almost never be wrong.

extraction.micro.precision.why: Wrong values are worse than missing ones (missing → RFI, wrong → bad decision).

extraction.micro.f1.why: Overall extraction quality on the frozen golden set (synthetic).

extraction.calibration.ece.why: Confidence routing only works if confidence means what it says.

extraction.latency_ms.p95.why: CPU rules path per sheet (LLM time is budgeted separately).

retrieval.recall_at_3.why: The right policy/spec passage must be in the top 3.

retrieval.injection_quarantined.why: Untrusted text that instructs the model must never reach the prompt.

retrieval.revision_aware.why: Only the policy revision in force on the date may be retrieved.

retrieval.contradiction_detected.why: Conflicting revisions must be surfaced, not silently merged.

grounding.abstention_accuracy.why: Answer when the sources cover it, abstain when they do not.

grounding.mean_groundedness_answered.why: Answered sentences must be supported by their citations.

change.field_change.f1.why: Detect which engineering fields changed between revisions.

change.severity_accuracy.why: Severity drives who reviews and who is notified.

change.receipt_reproducibility.why: Every cost/lead-time/severity number must re-compute bit-for-bit.

change.replay_identical.why: Case state rebuilt from the event log must equal the live state.

mro.status_accuracy.why: AD status correctness on the synthetic fleet.

mro.implicit_review_recall.why: Safety: evidence without an AD number must ALWAYS go to a human.

ap.false_auto_match.why: Safety: an exception must never be auto-matched for payment.

pdm.fd001_rmse.why: C-MAPSS FD001 test RMSE (capped at 125) — real public benchmark.

pdm.worst_rmse.why: No subset may regress badly (FD002/FD004 have 6 operating regimes).

pdm.min_coverage.why: Conformal 90% RUL intervals must cover at least 80% on every test subset.

pdm.min_health_auroc.why: Health score must separate early from late engine life.

safety.ece.why: Triage probabilities must be calibrated to set review priority.

safety.leakage_gap.why: Masking outcome words must barely change AUROC (model uses causes, not outcome words).

security.pass_rate.why: Every RBAC allow/deny and tenant-isolation check must hold.

pricing.test_coverage.why: Conformal 90% price intervals must actually cover ~90%.

judge.n.why: Judge calibration needs a few hundred human labels in production; 100+ here.

drift.confidence_psi_vs_first_half.why: PSI > 0.2 signals a distribution shift worth investigating.
